name: simplify-med
description: Helps patients around a medical visit: prepare for an appointment, simplify supplied clinical documents into a plain-language, source-anchored care plan, and take a brief personal health-literacy screen.

interface.shortDescription: Turn medical paperwork into a fact-checked plain-language report.
interface.longDescription: Prep gets a patient ready for an appointment with stated requirements, a things-to-bring checklist, and prioritized questions. Simplify turns supplied clinical documents into a plain-language, source-anchored care plan with deterministic validation and an audit trail. Med Lit runs a brief, opt-in health-literacy screen and returns a personal support profile.
defaultPrompt: Run the complete $simplify workflow on the supplied medical documents. Return only the validated final report and requested artifacts. Do not summarize the documents directly.
